name: 7740-longdecode-qwen3-4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-4B, ungated, served in its native bf16.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- an 8.05 GB bf16 checkpoint on one 80 GB card.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 4.02B dense, bf16, no quantization. 36 decoder layers, hidden 2560, GQA 32 query heads over 8 key/value heads at head_dim 128, tied embeddings, rope_theta 1e6, max_position_embeddings 40960.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 384 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts ~512 tokens over [128, 1024] (stdev 192), generations ~1024 tokens over [512, 1536] (stdev 256), temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true so every request generates its full sampled length.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant drafting roughly thousand-token replies for 16 concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine then runs
# without something this file declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-4B
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.8
attention-backend: fa3
